DIRECTION — Locomotive editorial.
Structure and stance lifted from the reference; type, colour and copy are Oju's own.
Instrument Serif (display) / Archivo (text) / Space Mono (labels).

The engineering claim is carried by CONTENT, not by a dark background:
named stack in column 03, discipline column in the work index, a quantified outcome.
Everything in [BRACKETS] is a real fact you still owe — clients, projects, the metric, the email. Nothing here is invented.
